description: The evaluation's cases: pull requests in obi-ai-bot/oby (public) whose bug a later commit fixed. `commit` is the pull request's squash-merge commit and `base` its parent, so a seat reviews the change `base..commit` in a checkout of `commit`. `lines` are the lines of `commit`'s version that the fix removed or changed and that `commit` wrote (git blame through the fix's parent): a finding catches the bug when it names one of those files and its lines come within `window` of one of those lines. `bug` says, in this evaluation's words, what the fix's message says went wrong. eval/README.md says how the cases were chosen.

cases.bug: The secret scan lets a "password or secret" value through as a mere name whenever it holds one of the keywords anywhere, so real secrets such as my-secret-password, or monkeyForestTree ("key" in monkey), pass the scan.
With bubblewrap's --die-with-parent dropped, stopping an agent signals only the outer bwrap process: the sandbox's own process and the agent inside it keep running after Stop.
A Keychain item found is cached from when the slow security call answered, not from when it was asked, so a removed login keeps showing as signed in for longer than the 2 seconds promised.
A review whose Blocking heading says "none" still has the lines after it read as blocking findings, so an approving review turns into changes requested.
